themes.name: Mechanistic Interpretability of Internal Representations
themes.summary: This group develops methods to interpret and control internal representations of neural models, using probes, sparse autoencoders, activation patching, and steering. It examines concept geometry, attention-head specialization, and whether readouts reflect genuine structure versus artifacts. The papers differ in modalities and analyses, spanning language, vision, scientific, and driving models.

themes.name: Self-evolving LLM agents with memory and harness optimization
themes.summary: This group examines agents that improve themselves at test time by building persistent memory, evolving harnesses or prompts, transferring skills, and selecting practice tasks. It covers video, clinical, web, and coding settings and contrasts in-context experience with weight updates. The papers differ in whether they evolve external artifacts such as memories, harnesses, and prompts or adapt the policy itself, and in how they evaluate robustness and reuse.

themes.name: Executable Agent Benchmarks for Safety and Reliability
themes.summary: This group introduces benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that place LLM agents in executable, stateful environments such as economic markets, device-control worlds, multimodal workspaces, hospitals, trading backtests, and software-incident logs, so failures can be diagnosed beyond final-task success. They differ in domain and diagnostic focus, spanning safety violations under economic pressure, tool-registry conformance, long-horizon causal chains, provenance and recomputation of results, and statistical reliability. Several emphasize stage-decomposed scoring, matched controls, and label-free or look-ahead-free validation.

themes.name: Physics-aware world models for forecasting and control
themes.summary: This group develops world models that compress observations into latent states, impose physical constraints, and forecast or plan under exogenous drivers and interventions. Papers differ by domain—environmental forecasting, typhoon imagery, robot manipulation, games, and agent markets—and by emphasis on residual generation, goal-aware action refinement, safe offline planning, or faithfulness evaluation.

themes.name: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
themes.summary: This group examines security, trust, and authorization boundaries for LLM agents and multi-agent systems. Papers span adversarial prompting and jailbreaks, poisoned fine-tunes and graph continual learning backdoors, agent-card discovery attacks, authentication and zero-trust delegation, and audits of approval and refusal behavior; they differ by attack surface and defense layer.

themes.name: Auditing Clinical LLM Reliability and Evaluation Biases
themes.summary: This group audits clinical large language models across coding, advice, judging, prescribing, summarization, genomic resistance, and diagnostic conversations. It characterizes reliability failures such as hallucinations, self-preference, framing effects, omissions, and evidence-order sensitivity. The papers differ in whether they expose model behavior through stress tests, interpretability-guided retraining, complaint-derived evaluation, or source-framed diagnostic revision.

themes.name: Low-Bit LLM Quantization and KV Cache Compression
themes.summary: This group develops low-bit quantization and KV-cache compression methods for efficient large language model inference, spanning mixed-format matrix multiplication, variable-bit cache packing, and hardware-native format selection. Some papers target weight-activation quantization and cache reuse, while others address long-context federated fine-tuning or depth-recurrent architectures. They differ mainly in whether they compress model parameters, attention caches, or context states, and in how they preserve quality under memory and latency constraints.

themes.name: On-Policy Distillation and Self-Distillation for Agents
themes.summary: This group studies on-policy and self-distillation methods that use teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories for language-model reasoning and multi-turn agents. It examines offline caching, experience calibration, label-free self-teaching, and security or interaction side effects, proposing distributional, calibrated, and brief-based variants. The papers differ in whether they preserve distributional supervision, rely on labels, or analyze transfer risks and ReAct behavior.

themes.name: Vision-Language-Action Policy Adaptation and Robustness
themes.summary: This group develops and evaluates Vision-Language-Action policies for robotic manipulation, addressing robustness, forgetting, deployment, and sim-to-real transfer. Papers differ in whether they transfer adversarial robustness across tasks, merge VLM and VLA weights, use edge-assisted latent reasoning, self-calibrate to new robot cells, reconstruct training trajectories from egocentric human data, or route reinforcement-learned atomic skills.

highlights.title: A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights
highlights.theme: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
highlights.why: Reports that a backdoor trigger can be recovered from fine-tune weights alone without any forward pass, a surprising advance for backdoor detection.
highlights.key_result: The paper shows that a backdoor trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic, with no forward pass of the suspect, names one of the trigger phrase's own tokens as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary, and recovers an exact trigger token in 14 of 14 ordinary backdoors on SmolLM2-360M and GPT-2-medium.
evidence: We show the trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic reads a fine-tuned checkpoint with no forward pass of the suspect, no data, no labelled population of poisoned models and no prior knowledge that a backdoor exists, and names one of the trigger phrase's own tokens as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary.

Counting independent backdoors, it recovers an exact trigger token in 14 of 14 ordinary backdoors on SmolLM2-360M and GPT-2-medium---architectures differing in normalisation, attention layout and weight storage order.

highlights.title: Jailbreak LLMs with Linguistic Style as a Hidden Attack Surface
highlights.authors: Priyanshu Mohanty, Sarthakbrata Halder, Srikant Panda et al.
highlights.theme: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
highlights.why: Shows stylistic rewrites produce order-of-magnitude attack-success differences and links them to disrupted refusal representations, with a style-aware defense.
highlights.key_result: The paper shows that linguistic style is a systematic and previously overlooked attack surface for LLM safety, with stylistic rewrites of identical harmful goals producing order-of-magnitude differences in Attack Success Rate (ASR), some styles achieving up to 80% ASR while others remain below 6%. It introduces a lightweight single-pass attack framework and a style-aware Direct Preference Optimization defense that reduces ASR from 86% to 19.5% while largely preserving utility.
evidence: We show that linguistic style is a systematic and previously overlooked attack surface for LLM safety.

Across a diverse taxonomy of styles and multiple state-of-the-art models, stylistic rewrites of identical harmful goals produce order-of-magnitude differences in Attack Success Rate (ASR), with some styles achieving up to 80% ASR while others remain below 6%.

To exploit this vulnerability, we introduce a lightweight single-pass attack framework that combines a style-conditioned generator with a BERT-based style selector, achieving performance competitive with substantially more expensive multi-turn optimization methods.
Motivated by this finding, we develop a style-aware Direct Preference Optimization defense that reduces ASR from 86% to 19.5% while largely preserving utility.

highlights.title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
highlights.authors: Yuzhu Ling, Jiale Han, Benyou Wang
highlights.theme: Executable Agent Benchmarks for Safety and Reliability
highlights.why: EconSafeBench systematically shows all evaluated models violate safety under economic pressure, including without explicit unsafe requests, making it a timely benchmark.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces EconSafeBench, a benchmark containing 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations. Across eight LLMs, all evaluated models exhibit safety violations on the static benchmark, with overall violation rates ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%, and violations can occur even without an explicit unsafe request as initially compliant agents may begin to violate under increasing performance pressure.

highlights.title: The Judge Is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
highlights.authors: Zara Ansari, Shlok Natarajan, Vincent Yip et al.
highlights.theme: Auditing Clinical LLM Reliability and Evaluation Biases
highlights.why: Across 13,760 medical judgments, same-model judges systematically favor their own outputs, undermining LLM-as-judge evaluation in clinical settings.
highlights.key_result: The main finding is that every judge favored its own model's answers: on average, a judge placed its own answer 1.22 positions closer to first (95% CI [1.18, 1.26]) in Real-POCQi, while in MedSP1000 pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from +0.53 to +0.62 positions, with no clear difference by conversation length (p=0.17).
evidence: In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was +1.22 positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers.

In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from +0.53 to +0.62 positions, with no clear difference by conversation length (p=0.17).

highlights.title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
highlights.authors: Jiyun Han, Seongjoon Cho, Seungkyu Choi
highlights.theme: Low-Bit LLM Quantization and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: MeltKV's memory-aligned variable-bit packing and codebook sharing deliver large memory and latency reductions at sub-4-bit KV cache compression.
highlights.key_result: MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.

Experiments show MeltKV outperforms prior approaches in accuracy and hardware efficiency even in ultra-low-bit regimes, offering a practical solution for long-context LLM deployment.

highlights.title: Gradient-Guided Hardware-Native MIXFP4
highlights.authors: Jian-Jia Chen, Brian J. Chan, Wen-Hung Lee et al.
highlights.theme: Low-Bit LLM Quantization and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: FlipQuant uses hardware-compatible per-tile format selection to close 42.5 percent of NVFP4's perplexity gap with negligible GEMM overhead.
highlights.key_result: FlipQuant selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile and, at 16 64, closes 42.5% of NVFP4's PPL gap to BF16 on average across six language models and two corpora, compared with 13.3% for FourOverSix. Its native kernels execute 16 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively.
evidence: We introduce FlipQuant, which selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile. It keeps both quantized weight candidates fixed and learns a binary format map from end-to-end gradients of a bucketed KL loss to a BF16 teacher, re-evaluating them after each update. Native kernels execute 16 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. highlights.title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
highlights.theme: Auditing Clinical LLM Reliability and Evaluation Biases
highlights.why: Demonstrates that later arriving CT or metadata can overturn earlier VLM quality-control decisions, revealing a clinically important evidence-order bias.

New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
news.summary: Google launched new Ask Maps features on Android and iOS in the U.S. and across more than 200 global regions for planning itineraries, finding local appointments, and searching saved lists. The update includes agentic capabilities that find and call to book beauty, pet care, auto and home repair appointments, plus real-time route details such as live traffic, business hours, parking, weather, delays and tolls, and itineraries can be exported to Google Docs on desktop.

news.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
news.summary: Microsoft Research, UC Berkeley and Microsoft Security released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from an agent's past sessions in a repository to cut token costs without modifying the agent or model. Across 277 real bug-fixing tasks it reduced costs by 18.4–30.9% across multiple coding agents, with costs falling in every repository tested and task success rates broadly stable; profiling Claude Code on 60 SWE-Bench tasks found 30% of tool calls repeated earlier work after five completed tasks, 16 of 23 tool descriptions never called, and the 17% of failed tasks accounting for 32% of spending.

news.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
news.summary: At SC26 in Chicago, NVIDIA introduced the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit, a four-node cluster of DGX Spark systems connected in a ring over ConnectX-7 with no switch, providing 512GB of combined memory and 20TB of NVMe storage. NVIDIA says models with up to 700B parameters, such as DeepSeek V4.1, can be deployed locally across the four nodes with NVFP4, and demonstrated workloads include LAMMPS with Kokkos and NAMD, with an HPC SDK installation playbook coming soon.

news.title: How the World’s Most Advanced AI Infrastructure Supply Chain Invents the Future
news.summary: NVIDIA published an interview with Deb Shoquist, who leads operations and supply chain, describing her team's relationships with manufacturers including TSMC (partner since 1998), Foxconn, Wistron, SPIL, KYEC, Unimicron, Lumentum, Coherent and Amkor. She cited Amphenol's cable cartridge, with 1,500 small cable legs assembled to under 1 DPPM on over a hundred automated lines, and noted she meets key suppliers quarterly and spends six weeks a year visiting partners in Taiwan, China, Korea, Vietnam and the U.S.; she received the 2026 Dr. Lisa Su Woman of Innovation Award.

news.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
news.summary: Lambda is deploying NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, reporting about 4% lower network latency at rack scale and up to about 10% at pod scale at the same throughput as pluggable optics. NVIDIA cites up to 5x better power efficiency, up to 15x higher reliability and 4x fewer lasers versus pluggable optics; each switch has 144 ports at 800Gb/s and 18 removable external light sources, and Lambda reports a median optics temperature of 36°C versus 51°C for pluggable optics.

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing
news.summary: A new Slurm release lets QPU builders expose their hardware to supercomputing centers through a single simple file, building on the QRMI and QDMI interfaces, and is being adopted by Alice & Bob, IBM, IQM, Pasqal, Quantinuum and MQSC; Slurm 26.11 ships later this month. NVIDIA reports nearly 30 supercomputing centers deploying over 50 quantum processors, a near sevenfold rise in five years, and announced CUDA-Q updates including a TCBP-JOBS decoder claimed 13,000x faster than the industry standard.

news.title: Accelerate Molecular Dynamics Simulations with Accurate, Flexible Primitives Using NVIDIA cuPotential
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuPotential, a library of modular C API primitives that accelerate long-range electrostatics and dispersion evaluation in molecular dynamics, with an OpenMM plugin replacing the nonbonded force, Langevin integrator and Monte Carlo barostat with minimal code changes. Benchmarks from T4 to RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell show 2x to over 3x end-to-end speedups for systems of 24,000 to 400,000 atoms under NPT, and energy drift over 10 ns is reduced several hundred fold versus default PME; new splitting and spreading functions were developed with D. E. Shaw Research and the Flatiron Institute.

news.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Leads Agentic Inference Performance on MLPerf Endpoints v1.0
news.summary: Provisional MLPerf Endpoints v1.0 results show NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 delivering over 10x the throughput per kilowatt of GB300 NVL72 at a shared minimum end-to-end interactivity of 50 tokens per second per user, and 5x to 10x higher throughput per kilowatt with 3x to 5x higher interactivity at matched concurrency across Kimi K3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. The cited Kimi K3 run used 32 accelerators at 1,024 queries concurrency, 41,414.2 tokens/sec system throughput, TTFT P90 of 4,673.9 ms and 100.89 kW operating power.

news.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Achieves up to 2x Blackwell Ultra Performance in MLPerf Training v6.1
news.summary: In its MLPerf Training v6.1 debut, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered the fastest time to train on six of seven benchmarks, with up to 2x more performance per GPU than an optimized GB300 NVL72 baseline. It trained the DeepSeek-V3 671B MoE benchmark in 4.14 minutes on 1,024 GPUs versus 8.03 minutes for GB300 NVL72, led the Qwen 3.5 397B GRPO benchmark at 10.44 minutes, and maintained above 97% scaling efficiency from 256 to 1,024 GPUs via NVLink 6 at 3.6 TB/s per GPU.

news.title: Post-Training NVIDIA Nemotron to Increase Accuracy in Your Scientific Domain
news.summary: NVIDIA published a recipe for post-training its open multimodal Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on scientific tasks, building a custom RL environment from experimental data with NeMo Gym and applying RL with NVIDIA NeMo RL, using drug-metabolism prediction and MetxBioDB records as the example. In that example supervised fine-tuning improved accuracy by 12% and RL post-training added a further 17% at a 16,384-token output budget, with an optional distillation step using a teacher model such as Claude Sonnet 5.5; the release also includes the Nemotron RL Litmus-Bench V2.0 chemistry benchmark.

news.title: Build memory-aware AI agents with Agentic Retrieve on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base and AgentCore memory now store conversations, extract facts and feed relevant facts into retrieval when a memoryConfiguration is added to the AgenticRetrieveStream request, with a planner deciding when user facts help compose sub-queries. The integration is opt-in and backward compatible, and a userContext field restricts returned documents to those permitted by the user's ACLs, with the post walking through per-user memory isolation enforced by IAM.

news.title: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: Duco, which processes 20 billion transactions monthly for 200+ clients including 7 of the top 20 banks and 10 of the top 20 asset managers, described moving from traditional machine learning to Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore for its agentic AI stack. The post cites model choice through a single API, private VPC endpoints keeping data isolated and not used for model training, and claims of reduced deployment time and onboarding costs.

news.title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing
news.summary: An AWS post lays out a taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns split into Tier 1 deterministic control flow (sequential pipeline, conditional workflow, conditional router, parallel workflow) and Tier 2 runtime-chosen paths, plus anti-patterns such as unbounded iteration. It cites that roughly 88% of AI pilots never reach production and that ten steps each 95% reliable yield 59.9% end-to-end reliability, while 20 steps yield 35.8%, and draws on manufacturing concepts including takt time and shift cycles.

news.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: MoEngage built its Merlin AI agents, including copywriter, designer, segment assist and template builder modes, on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, exposing existing APIs as MCP tools so assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT get tenant-scoped access to segments, campaign history and content. The platform serves more than 1,350 consumer brands, uses Claude Sonnet 4.6, 5 and 5.5 for reasoning and generation, and customer Glance saw a 38% uplift in push notification click-through rates.

highlights.title: A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights
highlights.theme: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
highlights.why: 报告称，后门触发器可仅从微调权重中恢复，无需任何前向传播，这是后门检测领域令人惊讶的进展。
highlights.key_result: 本文表明，后门触发器仅从权重中即可辨识：一个静态统计量，在不对嫌疑模型进行前向传播的情况下，将触发短语自身的一个 token 列为词汇表中排名最高的单一候选，并在 SmolLM2-360M 和 GPT-2-medium 上的 14 of 14 个普通后门中恢复了精确的触发 token。

highlights.title: Jailbreak LLMs with Linguistic Style as a Hidden Attack Surface
highlights.authors: Priyanshu Mohanty, Sarthakbrata Halder, Srikant Panda et al.
highlights.theme: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
highlights.why: 表明风格化改写会产生数量级的攻击成功率差异，并将其与拒绝表征受到破坏联系起来，同时提出了一种风格感知防御。
highlights.key_result: 本文表明，语言风格是 LLM 安全中一个系统性的、此前被忽视的攻击面；对同一有害目标进行风格化改写会在攻击成功率（ASR）上产生数量级差异，某些风格最高可达 80% 的 ASR，而其他风格仍低于 6%。本文提出一种轻量级单遍攻击框架，以及一种风格感知的直接偏好优化防御方法，将 ASR 从 86% 降低至 19.5%，同时基本保持实用性。

To exploit this vulnerability, we introduce a lightweight single-pass attack framework that combines a style-conditioned generator with a BERT-based style selector, achieving performance competitive with substantially more expensive multi-turn optimization methods.

highlights.title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
highlights.authors: Yuzhu Ling, Jiale Han, Benyou Wang
highlights.theme: Executable Agent Benchmarks for Safety and Reliability
highlights.why: EconSafeBench 系统地表明，在经济压力下所有被评估模型都会违反安全规定，包括在没有明确不安全请求的情况下，使其成为一个及时的基准。
highlights.key_result: 本文介绍了 EconSafeBench，一个包含 828 个案例、涵盖五个经济场景和四类安全违规的基准。在八个 LLM 中，所有评估模型在静态基准上均出现安全违规，总体违规率在 8.5% 到 40.6% 之间，而且即使没有明确的不安全请求，违规也可能发生，因为最初合规的智能体在性能压力增大时可能开始违规。
evidence: EconSafeBench contains 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations.
Across eight LLMs, all evaluated models exhibit safety violations on the static benchmark, with overall violation rates ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%.
We further find that violations can occur even without an explicit unsafe request, and that initially compliant agents may begin to violate as performance pressure increases over time.

highlights.title: The Judge Is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
highlights.authors: Zara Ansari, Shlok Natarajan, Vincent Yip et al.
highlights.theme: Auditing Clinical LLM Reliability and Evaluation Biases
highlights.why: 在 13,760 次医学评判中，同模型评判者系统性地偏向自身输出，损害了临床环境中 LLM 作为评判者的评估可靠性。
highlights.key_result: 主要发现是，每个评判模型都偏向自己模型的答案：在 Real-POCQi 中，平均而言评判模型将自己答案的排名向第一位拉近 1.22 个位次（95% CI [1.18, 1.26]）；而在 MedSP1000 汇总中，答案排名偏差从 +0.53 到 +0.62 个位次不等，且对话长度没有明显差异（p=0.17）。
evidence: In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was +1.22 positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers.
On average, a judge placed its own answer 1.22 positions closer to first than the other judges placed that same answer (95% CI [1.18, 1.26]).
In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from +0.53 to +0.62 positions, with no clear difference by conversation length (p=0.17).

highlights.title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
highlights.authors: Jiyun Han, Seongjoon Cho, Seungkyu Choi
highlights.theme: Low-Bit LLM Quantization and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: MeltKV 的内存对齐可变位打包和码本共享，在低于 4 bit 的 KV cache 压缩下带来了大幅内存和延迟降低。
highlights.key_result: MeltKV 将 KV 表示有效压缩到低于 4 bit 的水平，最低至 1 bit；在可比的困惑度下，与最先进的 VQ 方法相比，内存使用降低 48.1%，延迟降低 52.9%。
evidence: Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.
Experiments show MeltKV outperforms prior approaches in accuracy and hardware efficiency even in ultra-low-bit regimes, offering a practical solution for long-context LLM deployment.

highlights.title: Gradient-Guided Hardware-Native MIXFP4
highlights.authors: Jian-Jia Chen, Brian J. Chan, Wen-Hung Lee et al.
highlights.theme: Low-Bit LLM Quantization and KV Cache Compression
highlights.why: FlipQuant 使用硬件兼容的逐 tile 格式选择，以可忽略的 GEMM 开销弥合了 NVFP4 困惑度差距的 42.5%。
highlights.key_result: FlipQuant 为每个 MMA 权重 tile 选择 E2M1 或 E0M3，在 16 64 下，平均在六个语言模型和两个语料库上将 NVFP4 与 BF16 的 PPL 差距缩小了 42.5%，而 FourOverSix 为 13.3%。其原生内核在 SM120 上执行 16 64 tile，在 SM100 上执行 256 64 tile，GEMM 中位开销分别为 1.9% 和 1.7%。
evidence: We introduce FlipQuant, which selects E2M1 or E0M3 for each MMA weight tile. It keeps both quantized weight candidates fixed and learns a binary format map from end-to-end gradients of a bucketed KL loss to a BF16 teacher, re-evaluating them after each update. Native kernels execute 16 64 tiles on SM120 and 256 64 tiles on SM100 with median GEMM overheads of 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. Across six language models and two corpora, FlipQuant at 16 64 closes 42.5% of NVFP4's PPL gap to BF16 on average, compared with 13.3% for FourOverSix.

highlights.title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
highlights.theme: Auditing Clinical LLM Reliability and Evaluation Biases
highlights.why: 表明后到的 CT 或元数据可以推翻先前的 VLM 质量控制决策，揭示了临床上重要的证据顺序偏差。
highlights.key_result: 在 60 个存在覆盖缺陷的 NLST 胸部 CT 图像对中（其真值由扫描几何计算得出），一个虚假的 header 在与图像同时展示时被 Claude Haiku 5.5 拒绝（其检测结果中有 2% 被推翻），但当它在模型回答之后到达时，却推翻了其中 91% 的结果（Nemotron-3.5-VL 为 43% 对比 100%）。当顺序颠倒后，图像推翻了 header 错误的 98–100%：无论哪个来源后出现，谁就胜出。
evidence: On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98--100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won.

On defects each model had refused from the image alone, the same false header overruled the refusal far more often after the model's answer than with the image. Aligned view: Haiku 2% [1, 4] vs 91% [86, 95] (paired difference +88 points [83, 93]); Nemotron 43% vs 100% (+57 [53, 62]); Sonnet 0/178 vs 21% [16, 26]; Gemma 11% vs 64% (15 patients).

highlights.title: We Have All the Cards: Securing Agent Cards at the Operational Trust Boundary of the Agent2Agent Protocol
highlights.authors: Miguel A. Guirao Aguilera, Satyajayant Misra, Efren Lopez-Morales
highlights.theme: Security and Trust Boundaries for LLM Agents
highlights.why: 生态级 A2A 探测和真实卡片扰动基准刻画了 Agent Card 发现攻击，并验证了一种具有高召回率的语义防御。
highlights.key_result: 在注入真实 Agent Card 的受控攻击上，最强的语义评判模型在 1.7% 的误报率下实现了 97.0% 的安全召回率。在合成基准上，九个 LLM 评判模型的安全召回率从 25.8% 到 92.3% 不等，表明存在显著的模型依赖性差异。
evidence: On controlled attacks injected into real Agent Cards, the strongest semantic judge achieves 97.0% security recall at a 1.7% false-positive rate.
Across nine LLM judges on the synthetic benchmark, security recall ranges from 25.8% to 92.3%, demonstrating substantial model-dependent variation.

news.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
news.summary: Microsoft Research、UC Berkeley 和 Microsoft Security 发布了 TokenEconomizer，这是一个开源插件，它从智能体在某个仓库中的过往会话中学习，以在不修改智能体或模型的情况下降低 token 成本。在 277 个真实缺陷修复任务中，它在多个编码智能体上降低了 18.4–30.9% 的成本，所有测试仓库的成本均下降，任务成功率基本稳定；在 60 个 SWE-Bench 任务上对 Claude Code 进行剖析发现，完成五个任务后，30% 的工具调用重复了之前的工作，23 个工具描述中有 16 个从未被调用，17% 的失败任务占了 32% 的支出。

news.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
news.summary: 在芝加哥举行的 SC26 上，NVIDIA 推出了 DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit，这是一个由 4 台 DGX Spark 组成的环形集群，通过 ConnectX-7 互联且无交换机，提供 512GB 总内存和 20TB NVMe 存储。NVIDIA 表示，最多 700B 参数的模型（如 DeepSeek V4.1）可通过 NVFP4 在 4 个节点上本地部署；演示的工作负载包括采用 Kokkos 的 LAMMPS 和 NAMD，HPC SDK 安装手册即将发布。

news.title: How the World’s Most Advanced AI Infrastructure Supply Chain Invents the Future
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了对 Deb Shoquist 的采访，她负责运营和供应链，介绍了她的团队与制造商的关系，包括 TSMC（自 1998 年以来的合作伙伴）、Foxconn、Wistron、SPIL、KYEC、Unimicron、Lumentum、Coherent 和 Amkor。她提到 Amphenol 的电缆卡匣，在一百多条自动化产线上将 1,500 根小电缆脚组装到低于 1 DPPM，并指出她每季度与关键供应商会面，每年花六周时间拜访台湾、中国、韩国、越南和美国的合作伙伴；她获得了 2026 年 Dr. Lisa Su Woman of Innovation Award。

news.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
news.summary: Lambda 正在部署 NVIDIA Photonics 共封装光学交换机，以连接拥有超过 10,000 个 GPU 的 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 机架；在相同吞吐量下，相比可插拔光学器件，其机架级网络延迟降低约 4%，pod 级最高降低约 10%。NVIDIA 表示，与可插拔光学器件相比，电源效率最高提升 5x，可靠性最高提升 15x，激光器数量减少 4x；每个交换机拥有 144 个 800Gb/s 端口和 18 个可插拔外部光源；Lambda 报告光学器件中位温度为 36°C，而可插拔光学器件为 51°C。

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing
news.summary: 新的 Slurm 版本允许 QPU 构建者通过一个简单的文件向超级计算中心公开其硬件，基于 QRMI 和 QDMI 接口，并正被 Alice & Bob、IBM、IQM、Pasqal、Quantinuum 和 MQSC 采用；Slurm 26.11 将于本月晚些时候发布。NVIDIA 报告称，近 30 个超级计算中心部署了 50 多个量子处理器，五年内增长近七倍，并宣布了 CUDA-Q 更新，包括一个据称比行业标准快 13,000x 的 TCBP-JOBS 解码器。

news.title: Accelerate Molecular Dynamics Simulations with Accurate, Flexible Primitives Using NVIDIA cuPotential
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 cuPotential，这是一个模块化 C API 原语库，可加速分子动力学中的长程静电和色散计算；其 OpenMM 插件以最小的代码更改替换了非键力、Langevin 积分器和 Monte Carlo 恒压器。从 T4 到 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 的基准测试显示，在 NPT 系综下，对于 24,000 到 400,000 个原子的体系，端到端加速为 2x 到 3x 以上；与默认 PME 相比，10 ns 内的能量漂移降低了数百倍；新的分裂和扩展函数是与 D. E. Shaw Research 以及 Flatiron Institute 共同开发的。

news.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Leads Agentic Inference Performance on MLPerf Endpoints v1.0
news.summary: 临时 MLPerf Endpoints v1.0 结果显示，NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 在每用户每秒 50 tokens 的最低端到端交互性下，每千瓦吞吐量超过 GB300 NVL72 的 10x，并且在匹配并发下，在 Kimi K3、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上每千瓦吞吐量提高 5x 到 10x，交互性提高 3x 到 5x。所引用的 Kimi K3 运行使用 32 个加速器，并发 1,024 个查询，系统吞吐量为 41,414.2 tokens/sec，TTFT P90 为 4,673.9 ms，运行功耗为 100.89 kW。

news.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Achieves up to 2x Blackwell Ultra Performance in MLPerf Training v6.1
news.summary: 在其 MLPerf Training v6.1 首秀中，NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 在七个基准中的六个上取得了最快训练时间，每 GPU 性能比优化的 GB300 NVL72 基线最高提升 2x。它在 1,024 个 GPU 上用 4.14 分钟训练了 DeepSeek-V3 671B MoE 基准，而 GB300 NVL72 为 8.03 分钟；它在 Qwen 3.5 397B GRPO 基准上以 10.44 分钟领先，并通过 NVLink 6（每 GPU 3.6 TB/s）在 256 到 1,024 个 GPU 上保持了 97% 以上的扩展效率。

news.title: Post-Training NVIDIA Nemotron to Increase Accuracy in Your Scientific Domain
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了一份用于在科学任务上对其开源多模态 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 进行后训练的配方，使用 NeMo Gym 从实验数据构建自定义 RL 环境，并使用 NVIDIA NeMo RL 应用 RL，以药物代谢预测和 MetxBioDB 记录为例。在该示例中，监督微调将准确率提高了 12%，RL 后训练在 16,384 token 的输出预算下又提高了 17%；还有一个可选的蒸馏步骤，使用 Claude Sonnet 5.5 等教师模型；该发布还包括 Nemotron RL Litmus-Bench V2.0 化学基准。

news.title: Build memory-aware AI agents with Agentic Retrieve on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base 和 AgentCore memory 现在会存储对话、提取事实，并在向 AgenticRetrieveStream 请求添加 memoryConfiguration 时，将相关事实输入检索；规划器会决定用户事实何时有助于组成子查询。此集成是可选的且向后兼容；userContext 字段将返回文档限制在用户 ACL 允许的范围内；文章还演示了通过 IAM 实施按用户内存隔离。

news.title: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: Duco 每月为 200+ 个客户处理 20 billion 笔交易，客户包括前 20 大银行中的 7 家和前 20 大资产管理公司中的 10 家；该公司介绍了将其 agentic AI 技术栈从传统机器学习迁移到 Amazon Bedrock 和 Bedrock AgentCore 的过程。文章提到通过单一 API 选择模型、私有 VPC 端点保持数据隔离且不用于模型训练，并声称缩短了部署时间和降低了接入成本。

news.title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing
news.summary: 一篇 AWS 文章提出了多智能体设计模式的分类法，分为 Tier 1 确定性控制流（顺序流水线、条件工作流、条件路由、并行工作流）和 Tier 2 运行时选择路径，以及无界迭代等反模式。文章指出，约 88% 的 AI 试点从未进入生产，十个步骤每个步骤 95% 可靠时端到端可靠性为 59.9%，而 20 个步骤为 35.8%，并借鉴了制造业概念，包括 takt time 和 shift cycles。

news.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: MoEngage 构建了其 Merlin AI 智能体，包括文案撰写、设计、细分辅助和模板构建模式，基于 Amazon Bedrock 和 Bedrock AgentCore，将现有 API 暴露为 MCP 工具，以便 Claude 和 ChatGPT 等助手获得租户范围的细分、活动历史和内容访问权限。该平台为超过 1,350 个消费品牌提供服务，使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6、5 和 5.5 进行推理和生成；其客户 Glance 的推送通知点击率提升了 38%。
